'''Wentell Pron''' was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who worked with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] [[Republic Army|army]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He stayed on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] during part of the war, where he aided in the fight against the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]] in the [[Separatist War|Ord Mantell Civil War]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Biography==
Wentell Pron was a [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked as a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a conflict between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] and the Republic. During the war, he helped the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Republic Army|army]] and worked with them on the Republic-held [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] in the [[Bright Jewel system/Legends|Bright Jewel system]]<ref name="The New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]].<ref name="The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref> Whilst stationed on the planet, he and all Republic forces aided the corrupt local government in fighting the [[Mantellian Separatist Movement]].<ref name="TOR" />

During the civil war he stayed in [[Fort Garnik]], a Republic stronghold on the planet, where he worked with another Rodian named [[Tweeta]]. Pron looked to make new connections in the smuggling world whilst on the planet, and Tweeta would direct anyone she met who she suspected shared her trade to him.<ref name="TOR" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
Tweeta at one point in the war directed a [[Voidhound|Smuggler]] who worked with [[Rendia Freight]] to Wentell. The smuggler paid the Rodian at least once to teach them a number of combat and smuggling techniques.<ref name="TOR" />
{{Endgame}}

==Equipment==
During his time at Garnik, Wentell Pron wore a jacket [[Color/Legends|colored]] in red, brown, and yellow, along with a pair of brown and yellow pants and boots. He was armed with a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]], which he kept attached to his belt at the hip when not in use.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Wentell Pron is a non-player character from the [[Star Wars video games#Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]]. He is the first [[Smuggler/Legends|Smuggler]]-class trainer in the game and the only one on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]]. Players of the Imperial faction cannot interact with Pron, as there is currently no way Imperial characters can travel to Ord Mantell.<ref name="TOR" />
